verdict.rationale: Docs confirm Datalab (via Marker) converts PDFs into Markdown/HTML/JSON and offers segmentation, extraction, and pipeline chaining, implying general parsing capability, but there is no first-party or independent evidence specifically addressing handling of multi-column layouts, headers/footers, or footnote ordering. A community comment about Chandra-OCR raises a tangential concern about round-trip fidelity, not layout-order accuracy, so it doesn't concretely dispute the claim. missing for 10: benchmark or hands-on test showing correct reading order on multi-column PDFs, explicit documentation of header/footer/footnote handling, independent accuracy validation.
